overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals elected Andre Leroux as chair, reviewed an administrative zoning appeal, and acted on several special permit and variance applications. The board approved a lot width variance for a two-family dwelling and a change of non-conforming use for an engineering business while upholding a zoning violation citation regarding domestic chickens.

items.title: Election of Board Chair
items.summary: Elected Andre Leroux to serve as board chair following a nomination by Mary Lee.

items.title: 85 Elm Street Extension Request
items.summary: Approved a six-month extension for variances granted to demolish a motor vehicle repair shop and construct a three-unit dwelling.

items.title: Special Permit – 7 Tyrell Road
items.summary: Approved a special permit allowing the construction of a side porch awning encroaching into the side yard setback.

items.title: Zoning Appeal – 33 Watson Street
items.summary: Upheld a zoning violation citation for keeping chickens in a residential district after a motion to overturn the building commissioner's determination failed to secure a supermajority.

items.title: Lot Width Variance – 145 Jerome Street
items.summary: Approved a lot width variance to construct a two-family dwelling, conditioned on completing a lot line adjustment for a 6,000-square-foot lot and demolishing a structure on an adjacent parcel.

items.title: Special Permit – 42 Dexter Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit to change the non-conforming use of a commercial garage to an engineering prototyping and services business.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the board's meeting minutes for January and February.
